fields.Name: T266 - Knowledge Configuration Thresholds Edit and Unsaved Save Bar
fields.Description: Exercises the config dirty-tracking (OnSettingChanged/HasUnsavedChanges) and Reset path via threshold sliders — a distinct edit/unsaved-changes round-trip separate from the read-only setup and scope sections.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub 'Configuration' screen (via application switcher then Configuration), open the 'Thresholds' section in the inner rail. It shows range sliders (Duplicate Absolute Match, Duplicate Potential Match, Search Relevance, Autotag Confidence) with live percentage labels. Drag/change one slider and confirm two things: the percentage label updates, AND an 'Unsaved changes' indicator plus a Save/Reset save bar appears. Then click 'Reset' and confirm the unsaved-changes state clears. You do NOT need to persist a save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Thresholds section renders sliders with live percentage labels
Changing a slider updates its label and surfaces an 'Unsaved changes' badge with a Save/Reset bar; clicking Reset clears the unsaved state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
